verdict.rationale: The x402 Bazaar is a documented public catalog of payment-gated services. Agents can search it by intent with network, asset, scheme and price filters, through keyless discovery APIs, a TypeScript SDK, an OpenAPI client, or the Bazaar MCP server, and it lists more than 23,000 resources. A runtime probe confirmed the keyless discovery endpoint returns real payable listings. missing for 10: independent community corroboration of agents using Bazaar discovery in practice (the only hands-on evidence is a vendor-side probe), and search is capped at 20 results per query.
